name: The Bank of China | openEuler
description: The Bank of China (BOC) has been driving IT innovation across its IT infrastructure since 2020. Central to this effort is the large-scale deployment of Kylin OS. Since 2020, BOC has deployed over 100,000 sets of Kylin OS within its internal network, which represents more than 70% of the bank's total internal network.
